lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Sow in good residual conserved moisture.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Seed treatment with Trichoderma @ 6g/kg or Apron 35SD for white rust/damping off.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check seed purity (>98%) and bold grain size.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Use certified varieties (e.g. RH 749, Pusa Mustard 25, Giriraj).

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 2. खेत की तैयारी एवं बेसल सल्फर
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Conserve subsoil moisture through planking immediately after ploughing.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Basal application of FYM (5 t/ha) + Single Super Phosphate (SSP) for phosphorus & sulphur + full K and 50% N.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sulphur (20-30 kg/ha via SSP or Bentonite Sulphur) is essential for oil synthesis in mustard.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Sow at 3-4 cm shallow depth in moist soil.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Watch for painted bug on newly emerging seedlings.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Maintain 30x10-15 cm row and plant geometry.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: No irrigation needed if emergence is healthy.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for painted bug (Bagrada cruciferarum) and flea beetles.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Crucial thinning at 15-20 DAS: leave only 1 healthy plant per hill to avoid overcrowding.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: 1st irrigation at 28-35 DAS (pre-flowering stage); vital for branching.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Top-dress remaining 50% Nitrogen (Urea) immediately after 1st irrigation.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) colonies on tender growing tips and white rust pustules.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Avoid heavy flood irrigation during peak bloom to prevent flower drop.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of 19:19:19 @ 1% or water soluble Boron @ 0.1%.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Intensive aphid scouting; count aphids per 10 cm central twig (ETL: 25-30 aphids/twig).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Protect honeybees during peak morning pollination hours.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: 2nd irrigation at pod development stage (65-75 DAS).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of 0:0:50 (Potassium sulphate) @ 1% for seed test weight.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Sclerotinia stem rot and Alternaria black blight on pods.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Irrigate on windless evenings to prevent lodging.
Harvest when 75-80% pods turn bright yellow/golden to prevent pod shattering.
Harvest in early morning hours when pods are moist with dew to avoid seed shattering.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for storage molds and rancidity.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sun dry seeds until moisture is <= 8% to preserve high oil content and prevent rancidity.
